description_html:
The SMOK D-Coil Meshed is a replacement coil for compatible SMOK devices.

  • Product Type: Replacement Coil
  • Coil Resistance: 0.15Ω / 0.23Ω
  • Coil Material: Dual Mesh
  • Compatible Devices: SMOK TF-D Subtank (X-Priv Solo & X-Priv Plus kits)
  • Pack Quantity: 5 Coils
  • Brand: SMOK

Coils are consumable - replace when flavour or vapour output drops.

Available options: 0.23 ohm 5/PK, 0.15 ohm 5/PK.
